That archive/delete split is exactly what I want. Archiving should be reversible and preserve everything, while deletion should be permanent and require a clear confirmation. Archived links should remain hidden from normal lists and searches but searchable within the Archived view.

Four visible actions will feel cluttered, especially on my phone. Keep the reading action and Edit readily available, and place Archive and Delete in a `⋯` menu. In the Archived view, Restore can be visible, with Delete kept in that menu.

With that adjustment, removing and restoring links feels right. Let’s move on to notes.
